items.text: Lamar Jackson present for start of Thursday practice (limited earlier in week).
items.why: Ankle injury; first presence after missing two games
items.implication: Boost for Flowers/Andrews if plays vs CIN

items.text: Saquon Barkley expected to return to practice Thursday and in line to play Monday vs Cowboys.
items.why: Hamstring; banged-up Eagles backfield with Hurts issues
items.opportunity: Full workload likely vs DAL soft vs RBs

items.text: Bears RB Kyle Monangai ruled OUT for TNF vs Patriots; third straight miss (toe/thumb).
Terrance Ferguson not expected ready soon after Adams injury; Rams' only answer is 25 Puka Nacua targets per game.
items.why: Ferguson delay post-Adams hamstring rupture 6-10 weeks/IR

items.text: Seahawks activated RB Zach Charbonnet from PUP; Arroyo season-ending shoulder surgery.
items.why: Full practice, ACL recovery complete enough for activation
items.implication: SEA RB committee; impacts Walker matchup as former teammate

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed in facility for meetings/lifting/medical; Lloyd (49th EPA/rush) and Johnson (53rd) bad amid OL mess. Long-term outlook discussed on ROS pod.
items.implication: Jacobs RB1 soon; fade current committee

items.text: Up in pace: TB @ CAR. Slow slogs: MIA @ NYJ. Other notes; full Thorman snaps/pace. GB/DET/LAR/LV high volume spots.
items.why: Neutral pace/PROE data; TB/CAR tempo, MIA/NYJ low snaps
items.opportunity: More snaps/routes in TB-CAR, GB-DET, LAR-LV

items.text: Terry McLaurin lost for season (torn patellar tendon); breaks down Commanders offense fallout.
items.why: Torn patellar on MNF vs SF; surgery

items.text: JJ McCarthy YPT to Justin Jefferson only 5.7 (vs Mullens 10.8, Cousins 10.5 etc); tough to ignore despite scheme/coach differences. Giants start McCarthy vs HOU.
items.why: Small sample YPT concern with McCarthy

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10) and DeVonta Smith vs DAL (WR11) for usage/matchups; Bears soft, volume elite.
items.why: Bears good for yardage; Smith elite volume

items.text: Loves Jaylen Warren @ NO (RB9), Chuba Hubbard vs TB (RB10), Bucky Irving @ CAR (RB12) for big workloads/friendly matchups.
items.why: Workloads vs defenses carved by RBs; Hubbard consistent

items.text: Hates Josh Jacobs @ DET (RB18) workload questions post-layoff; Cam Skattebo @ HOU (RB37) brutal spot.
items.why: Layoff uncertainty; Skattebo role/matchup poor (benched notes)

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze vs NE (WR32), Josh Downs @ MIN (WR41), Travis Kelce @ SEA (TE9) for nasty matchups/roles.
items.why: Tough defenses; Downs target share low on low-scoring team

items.text: Bears soft ROS post-Wk10 bye: Saints(27th YPP), Lions(24), Jags(26), Dolphins(21), Bills(25), Packers(3), Lions(24). Recent scoring bounce.
